name: namespaces
description: Namespaces: independent version lines, the lookup through the shared namespace, a name that lives on one side of that lookup only, and the namespaces a create makes while the engine runs, which an archive freezes.

id.description: The instance id; the engine makes one when it is absent

namespace.description: The namespace that holds the instance

schemaNamespace.description: The namespace that holds the schema

version.description: The schema version the instance was last written with

seq.description: The sequence of the instance's last event: its entity tag

behaviors.description: The instance's behaviors' fields, by behavior name, apart from its own fields

notes.description: The notes, in the order they were written.

valueRefs.description: For a read with valueRefs: the JSON pointers into data of the fields that hold a ref, { "$value": <hash>, "bytes": <n> }, in place of a value the value store holds

limit.description: How many instances a page holds, 50 when absent

valueRefs.description: Return each field the value store holds as its ref, { "$value": <hash>, "bytes": <n> }, listed in valueRefs, rather than its value, which get_value reads

where.description: The values the instances hold, by field: a value, null for none, or a list of 1 to 100 meaning any of them; every member must hold

s13.useWhen: Use to page through Order instances, oldest first. where keeps the ones whose fields hold the values it gives, null meaning no value and a list of values any of them: title; a behavior's field by its qualified name, the behavior's, a dot and the field's.
s13.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to read one instance whose id you have; call get.
s13.success: Returns items and next; pass next as cursor for the page after, until it is null. With where, a page can hold fewer items than limit, even none, while next is not null: read on until it is.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

patch.description: A JSON merge patch of the Order

s15.useWhen: Use to change the own fields of the Order with the id, as a JSON merge patch; with expectedSeq, the update is refused if the instance changed since that seq.
s15.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to set a behavior's field: the patch holds own fields only, and a behavior's fields change only through its operations.
s15.success: Returns the instance as the patch left it, with its next seq.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

s17.useWhen: Use to make a namespace for a new project: it starts with no schemas of its own and looks schema names up in the shared namespace after itself.
s17.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to make a schema; call define_schema in the namespace. Do not use for a name that is a namespace already, archived or not: the create is refused (conflict).
s17.success: Returns the namespace, active, with who made it and when.

s18.useWhen: Use when a project made with create_namespace is finished: its schemas, instances and events stay readable, every write is refused (namespace_archived), and its reactions and schedules stop.
s18.doNotUseWhen: Do not use on a namespace the engine's options configure, which is refused (conflict), or to remove data: nothing is removed.
s18.success: Returns the namespace, archived, with who archived it and when; archiving an archived namespace changes nothing.

operations.name: create
operations.title: Create Order
operations.description: Creates a Order: validates the instance, data, against the schema's live version and stores it under id, or under a new id when none is given.

guidance.useWhen: Use to create a new Order: data holds its own fields, and id names it, or the engine makes one.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to change one that exists; call update.
guidance.success: Returns the new instance with its id, its seq, its own fields in data and its behaviors' fields in behaviors, by behavior name.

operations.name: get
operations.title: Get Order
operations.description: Returns the Order with the id: its own fields in data, its behaviors' in behaviors.

valueRefs.description: Return each field the value store holds as its ref, { "$value": <hash>, "bytes": <n> }, listed in valueRefs, rather than its value, which get_value reads

guidance.useWhen: Use when you have the id of the Order to read.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to find Order instances; call list.
guidance.success: Returns the instance with its seq, its own fields in data and its behaviors' fields in behaviors, by behavior name.

operations.name: list
operations.title: List Order
operations.description: Lists Order instances in creation order, a page at a time: pass a page's next as cursor for the page after it. where keeps the instances whose fields hold the values it gives, a list meaning any of them; a filtered page can hold fewer than limit while next is not null.

next.description: The next page's cursor; null after the last page

operations.name: update
operations.title: Update Order
operations.description: Applies a JSON merge patch (RFC 7386) to the Order with the id: a member replaces the instance's, a nested object merges and null removes a member. With expectedSeq the update is refused unless the instance is still at that sequence.

operations.name: delete
operations.title: Delete Order
operations.description: Deletes the Order with the id. With expectedSeq the delete is refused unless the instance is still at that sequence.

expectedSeq.description: The sequence the caller last read (an instance's seq): the call is refused unless the instance is still at it

guidance.useWhen: Use to delete the Order with the id for good; with expectedSeq, the delete is refused if the instance changed since that seq.
guidance.success: Returns null; the instance and what its behaviors kept for it are gone.

operations.name: count
operations.title: Order: count
operations.description: Counts the notes of every instance of the schema.

tools.name: engine.getValue
tools.title: Get a stored value

mcp.name: Get a stored value
mcp.description: Returns a value the engine stores by its hash, { hash, bytes, value }: a field whose JSON is longer than the engine's threshold, which an event (and an instance read with valueRefs) carries as a ref, { "$value": <hash>, "bytes": <n> }. The caller must be able to read a schema of this namespace whose instances, events or behaviors hold the value.

superschematic/operation-guidance.useWhen: Use to read a large field an event, or an instance read with valueRefs, carries as a ref ({ "$value": <hash>, "bytes": <n> }), by its hash.
superschematic/operation-guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to read an instance; call its schema's get, which returns every field inline unless valueRefs asks for refs.
superschematic/operation-guidance.success: Returns the value with its hash and its size in bytes.

guidance.useWhen: Use to read a large field an event, or an instance read with valueRefs, carries as a ref ({ "$value": <hash>, "bytes": <n> }), by its hash.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to read an instance; call its schema's get, which returns every field inline unless valueRefs asks for refs.
guidance.success: Returns the value with its hash and its size in bytes.

tools.description: Returns a value the engine stores by its hash, { hash, bytes, value }: a field whose JSON is longer than the engine's threshold, which an event (and an instance read with valueRefs) carries as a ref, { "$value": <hash>, "bytes": <n> }. The caller must be able to read a schema of this namespace whose instances, events or behaviors hold the value.

hash.description: The value's hash: the SHA-256 of its canonical JSON, as a ref's $value holds it

returns.description: The value, with its hash and its canonical JSON's length in bytes
